cases.question: How does UN R16 relate to UN R94?
cases.answer:
UN-ECE-R16 applies to vehicles of various categories (M, N, O, L2, L4, L5, L6, L7, T) for the installation of safety-belts and restraint systems, as well as to vehicles of category M1 and N1 for child restraint systems and ISOFIX child restraint systems. [UN-ECE-R16 §1, p.5]

UN-ECE-R94 applies to vehicles of category M1 with a total permissible mass not exceeding 3,500 kg and to vehicles of category N1 with a total permissible mass not exceeding 2,500 kg, with other vehicles being subject to approval at the manufacturer's request. [UN-ECE-R94 §1, p.5]

UN-ECE-R16 specifies that safety-belts and restraint systems must be designed to reduce the risk of bodily injury in the event of an accident when correctly installed and properly used by an occupant. [UN-ECE-R16 §6, p.15]

UN-ECE-R94 involves the application for approval of a vehicle type concerning the protection of front seat occupants in the event of a frontal collision (offset deformable barrier test). [UN-ECE-R94 §3.1, p.9]
